label: The public, for themselves
definition: People reading or acting about their own health. The default for a campaign aimed at everyone.

label: Family and friends
definition: People who act for someone close to them.

label: Parents and caregivers
definition: Parents, guardians, grandparents and carers acting for a child or an adult they look after.

label: Partners and family members
definition: Spouses, partners, siblings and other relatives.

label: Friends and peers
definition: Friends, roommates, classmates, teammates, bystanders.

label: Health and care workers
definition: People who treat or care for patients.

label: Doctors
definition: Physicians of any specialty.

label: Primary care doctors and pediatricians
definition: Family doctors, GPs, internists, pediatricians.

label: Care home and home care staff
definition: Nursing assistants, personal care and aged-care workers.

label: Allied health professionals
definition: Therapists, technologists and technicians: physical, occupational, respiratory and speech therapy, imaging, dietitians, medical assistants. Added for TRAIN (2026-10-29).

label: Laboratory staff
definition: Clinical and public health laboratory scientists and technicians. Added for TRAIN (2026-10-29).

label: Addiction counselors
definition: SOC 2018 21-1018; O*NET splits it into 21-1011.00 (substance abuse and behavioral disorder) and 21-1014.00 (mental health).

label: Peer recovery and harm-reduction workers
definition: People with lived experience paid to support others, and harm-reduction outreach staff.

label: Hospital and clinic leaders
definition: Managers who set policy for a health system, hospital or clinic.

label: Public health workers
definition: Staff of health departments and prevention programs.

label: Community health workers
definition: Promotores, lay health workers, CHWs.

label: Environmental health staff
definition: Sanitarians, food, water, housing and lead inspectors. Added for TRAIN (2026-10-29).

label: Emergency management and preparedness staff
definition: Emergency managers and preparedness coordinators in health departments, hospitals and government. Added for TRAIN (2026-10-29).

label: Health departments and program managers
definition: The health department as an organization, and the managers who run its programs.

label: School and campus leaders
definition: Principals, superintendents, deans, residence life.

label: Celebrities, athletes and public figures
definition: Mainly a messenger value: famous people who front a campaign.

label: Other trusted messengers
definition: Elders, neighborhood leaders, people with lived experience speaking publicly.

label: Teens (13-17)
definition: MeSH Adolescent runs 13-18; campaigns for 18-year-olds go in Young adults.

label: Adults (25-64)
definition: Only when the campaign names an adult age range, not as a stand-in for everyone.

label: Older adults (65+)
definition: Campaigns saying 60+ or 55+ land here too.

label: Men who have sex with men
definition: A behavior, not an identity; used by HIV and STI campaigns.

label: White
definition: Rarely named; only when a campaign says so.

label: Indigenous peoples
definition: Works across countries.

label: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples
Workers
definition: Use a child when the job is named.

label: People in jail or prison or on probation
People who use or inject drugs
definition: The population harm-reduction campaigns serve. Pair with a Stage value.

label: People with long-term health conditions
definition: Patients, people on a long-term medication, the clinically vulnerable. The condition itself goes in Topic.

label: Speakers of other languages
definition: Campaigns made in a minority language (Arabic, Bengali, Hmong, Spanish outside Spanish-speaking countries).

label: Not started
definition: Prevention for people who don't do it yet.

label: At risk
definition: Experimenting, or in a group at high risk.

label: Doing it now
definition: People who use, drink, smoke, vape, gamble, or don't yet do the healthy behavior.

label: Ready to change
definition: Thinking about quitting, cutting down or starting.

label: Affected others
definition: Family, friends and people who have lost someone.
